title: Biorthogonal Conformal Dynamics in Non-Hermitian Quantum Quenches
abstract: BCFT description of global quenches extended to interacting non-Hermitian critical chains, where the left covector is part of the quench protocol. Independent left and right preparations define the two temporal boundaries of a strip with complex extrapolation parameters. In the interacting Yang-Lee spin chain, statically calibrated boundary data predict biorthogonal return amplitudes, a primary one-point function and a spatial correlator; the imaginary part of the linear-paired extrapolation parameter predicts the temporal center of an antilinear-paired one-point function at the 1e-3 relative level. Also tests a complex five-state Potts fixed point.
key_claims: Biorthogonal (left/right) BCFT framework for global quenches in the interacting Yang-Lee spin chain
Static calibration of boundary data predicts real-time biorthogonal dynamics at 1e-3 relative accuracy
Extends to a complex five-state Potts fixed point with complex primary dimensions
relevance_note: Abstract only, NOT read. Same model family and same biorthogonal left/right pairing as HYP-2026-028 / SIM-2026-070/071, and uses statically calibrated boundary data in the way SIM-070 calibrated g1/R_inf. It does not measure a central charge from Koo-Saleur modes, so it does not bear on the already-retracted c_KS novelty claim (ERRATA E7), but it is now required cite-adjacent prior art for ANY biorthogonal Yang-Lee boundary or dynamics claim this project makes. Relevance 4 because it is the closest in-window paper to an open hypothesis; it is tooling and prior art, not a new test.
